Messages.Author: Klaital
Messages.Body:
This deck started from me looking at Fantasy World and think of how awesome card it is. It pretty much guarantees no blocks or bounce from the guy you put it on, and its even at stealth to start with AND leaves them tapped for next turn. Like a Mind Numb on steroids, and you can even play it on an already tapped target.

So this is basically Ravnos tap and bleed. Gabrin is the star, both for his built-in path, which makes everything except Fantasy World free to him, and for his tap a dude special, and there is also couple deflections in to take use of his dominate. Rest of the crypt includes two copies of each of the 4 lowest cap Ravnos who can play Tumnimos and have superior Chimerstry in group 2.

Basically first you bring out Gabrin and two others and make 3-5 tumnimos. Then play week and use Fantasy Worlds and Gabrins tap special to remove blockers, and then swarm bleed. Masters are dedicated mostly for blood management because most of the cards in the deck cost blood, but Ravnos Carnival can make Tumnimos free after you got a few out, and Path makes pretty much everything else free. Tributes are in there as sort of a plan B to buy more time if something is going wrong.
